<thought>To locate the appropriate retrosynthetic template for a Friedel‑Crafts acylation, I will search the template catalog using a representative product (acetophenone, SMILES CC(=O)c1ccccc1). In the forward reaction an aryl halide is lost and a ketone (acyl group) is formed, creating a new aromatic‑sp2 C–C bond. The valid functional‑group names are “aryl halide” (broken) and “ketones” (formed). I will request a few matching templates.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "CC(=O)c1ccccc1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aryl halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ketones"],
    "bonds_formed": ["6-6"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
